Welcome to the U.S. Copyright Office

Welcome to the U.S. Copyright Office

Group Registration of Two-Dimensional Artwork (GR2D)

Group Registration of Two-Dimensional Artwork (GR2D)

Registration option now available

Search the Copyright Public Records System

Search the Copyright Public Records System

The Copyright Public Records System (CPRS) provides copyright registration and recordation data with advanced search capabilities, filters, and improved interfaces.

Start your search here

Intellectual Property Toolkits

Intellectual Property Toolkits

Our new toolkit can help you navigate the copyright registration system.

The Copyright Claims Board (CCB)

The Copyright Claims Board (CCB)

The CCB is available to resolve copyright disputes of up to $30,000 as an efficient, less expensive alternative to federal court.

United States Copyright Office Strategic Plan
2022–2026

United States Copyright Office Strategic Plan
2022–2026

Fostering Creativity and Enriching Culture

Previous Next

What is Copyright?

Learn about the basics of copyright with our online reference page.

Learn More

Onsite Service

Onsite Services in our Washington, DC, offices are available by appointment. To submit claims or discuss copyright-related matters, visit our Public Information Office by making an appointment. Copyright Office Reading Room services are available in the James Madison Memorial Building, room LM-463.

Features

Search Copyright Records

Search our online records, learn about our searching and retrieval services, and view educational videos and materials.

Learn About Records

Register Your Works

Register your work or learn more about the registration process with the Copyright Office.

Learn About Registering

Recordation

Record transfers of copyright ownership and other documents pertaining to copyright for indexing into our public records.

Learn About Recordation

Copyright Law

View current Copyright Law of the United States and related laws contained in Title 17 of the U.S. Code.

Learn About Copyright Law

Who We Are

Learn more about who we are, what we do, and how we can help.

Learn About Us

Fees

View current fees for registration, recordation, and other services.

Learn About Fees

Intellectual Property Toolkits

Intellectual property (IP) protects creations of the mind, and copyright is one type of IP.

The Copyright Registration Toolkit is a visual breakdown of copyright, including essential information about copyright law, how to prepare for copyright registration, what to expect during the process, and post-registration considerations.

Download the U.S. Copyright Office’s toolkit along with toolkits on trademarks, patents, and trade secrets developed by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

Learn More About the IP Toolkit
